mcq_choices.rationale: Assumes moving against the field lowers potential energy, as if borrowing the sign convention from motion with a field (or gravity) rather than against it.
potential rises opposite the field for positive charge
Assumes potential energy stays constant unless the charge moves along the field lines, ignoring the work done moving against the field.
Confuses energy-mass equivalence with ordinary electrostatic potential energy, a category error unrelated to this situation.

parts.prompt:

B. increase
C. remain zero
D. become mass

criteria.description: Select the single scientifically correct answer.
